subject: Run community edition of shiny server behind proxy

messages.author: 623d4c98fcdd361e
messages.subject: Run community edition of shiny server behind proxy
parts:
Hello!

Can I run my shiny server (community edition) behind a proxy?

What are the considerations?

Currently I'm able to view the Home page on my http://localhost:3838 but not able to view the apps that I deploy under /srv/shiny-server/ directory (Not even the example apps).

Please feel free to ask for more details.

Here is the link for a SO question with some more details.
http://stackoverflow.com/questions/36554331/shiny-app-unable-to-start-on-shiny-server

Thanks,
Megh
